errors.evidence: The description incorrectly labels the onion category. The chart label is 'Лук кромид - зрял' (Onion - mature), not 'лук кромид (вкл. лют)' (Onion (incl. hot)).

The description incorrectly lists the last categories on the x-axis. The chart shows separate categories for 'тикви и кратуни' (pumpkins and gourds) and 'краставици и корнишони' (cucumbers and gherkins), but the description combines them and omits 'кратуни'.
The vertical axis has major gridlines and labels at intervals of 20,000, not 10,000.

errors.text_span: Най-високият стълб, оцветен в оранжев, съответства на картофите, с добив над 180 000 тона
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The highest bar on the chart is the blue one (2022) for potatoes, with a value of approximately 175,000 tonnes. The orange bar (2023) for potatoes is significantly lower, around 120,000 tonnes. The value is also not 'над 180 000 тона'.

errors.text_span: докато стълбът за тикви и краставици и корнишони е най-къс, достигащ малко над 1000 тона
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly combines categories and significantly misreports the value. The lowest yields are for 'краставици и корнишони', and their values are between 5,000 and 8,000 tonnes, not 'малко над 1000 тона'.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете за картофи и дини показват по-високи стойности през 2023 г. в сравнение с 2022 г.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. For potatoes, the 2023 yield (orange bar) is visibly and significantly lower than the 2022 yield (blue bar). For watermelons, the yields are approximately the same for both years.

errors.text_span: докато за другите зеленчуци стойностите са относително близки в двете години
errors.evidence: This is an inaccurate over-generalization. There are visible differences for several other vegetables; for example, the yield for tomatoes is clearly lower in 2023 than in 2022, while the yield for peppers is visibly higher.
